method: Hangul bigrams + Latin words, report-level BM25 (k1=1.2, b=0.75): per-term idf, per-posting tf part quantised (sqrt) to 1..31; weight = idf * (k1 + 1) * (q / qmax) ** 2; paragraphs ranked client-side in the evidence pack; relation kinds from cue words in the sentence around each mention (rule-based, not a model).
